config.content:
## 261 broad → 3 refined ordered pairs

**261 → 3 reflects additional behavioural and ancestry requirements; it is not a measured false-positive reduction.** Both sets already require same-host GUID ancestry, strict ordering and a 60-second window. Refinement adds service-origin shell context and refined PowerShell behaviour.

**Separate corroboration unit:** 3 service → cmd → PowerShell triples / 9 participating events / 3 hosts.
config.title: Candidate Sequence Volume

config.content:
### 1 installation → 2 service-origin cmd.exe → 3 PowerShell · 41,801,900 ns

**Three-event corroborated candidate.** Shell process GUID equals the PowerShell parent GUID: ` {8e11608b-3ddb-672b-1705-000000000500} `. The service image association was independently validated against preserved SCM source evidence (normalized full command; lexical association).

**Malicious intent and final execution outcome are not independently proven.** This bounded sequence is not a complete incident timeline. **Triple ID:** ` f09a7676f6f7a5fea1aa767b84a4dbb50411cbdf1d66da690e98aa6a738ffa9c `

config.title: Supporting evidence · exact source references

config.content:
**Same host + service-origin context + exact process GUID ancestry + strict event ordering + bounded time + refined PowerShell behaviour.**

Independent ancestry and SCM image evidence make the candidate more structurally supported than isolated interpreter execution. Approved administration, service wrappers and marker-file tests can still satisfy every condition. Missing native PowerShell or service telemetry, absent GUIDs, renamed/in-process interpreters, alternate parents and longer delays can prevent a match.

**Coverage:** 102,011 source observations; 90,601 timed; 11,410 intentionally undated and excluded from ordering. Service-create and service-config remain separate cohorts. Individual units are distinct events within a rule; pairs and triples are ordered ID tuples. No independent intent truth exists to measure precision, recall or a false-positive rate. Missing fields display as **Unavailable**.
